full_prompt_en: A square crop of an ink-textured graphic illustration shows an elderly bearded gentleman standing against a nearly solid scarlet-red background. The red field fills the upper half and reaches the side edges without a horizon or detailed setting. Fine scratches and irregular black ink marks break its apparently flat surface, especially at the lower left behind the figure. At the center, the man faces almost directly forward, his bald head rising into the open red space. His face is drawn with dense dark hatching around the eyes, nose, and cheekbones, and his long white beard descends in a bright taper across his chest. A thick white mustache curves outward above the darker mouth area. The eyes appear deep set under shadowed brows, giving the still pose a stern, watchful character. A long red overcoat hangs from his shoulders to the lower edge of the image; its broad lapels, sleeves, and pockets are defined by rough black contours and short bands of crosshatching. Beneath it, a black waistcoat forms a strong vertical shape against the beard and red fabric. One pale hand rests over the top of a slim dark walking stick near the lower center-left. The other hand sits near the coat pocket, partly lost in shadow at the right side. The coat's red is close to the background color, so its silhouette is separated mainly by black ink strokes, patches of darkness, and a slight shift in value. Lighting is frontal and restrained: pale areas of the scalp, beard, and hand stand out, while the clothing and facial recesses hold heavy charcoal shadows. The image has a printed, slightly distressed surface rather than smooth photographic blending. The overall composition is stark and upright, using a limited red, black, and aged white palette to make the figure feel severe and theatrical.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形裁切的墨线肌理平面插画呈现一位年长的白胡子绅士，站在近乎纯色的猩红背景前。红色色域铺满画面上半部并延伸到两侧边缘，没有地平线或具体场景。细小刮痕和不规则黑色墨迹打破了表面的平整感，人物身后左下方尤其明显。男子位于中央，几乎正面朝向观者，光秃的头部伸入开阔的红色区域。眼睛、鼻子和颧骨周围以密集深色排线刻画，长白胡子沿胸前渐尖垂下，成为明亮的形体。浓密白色八字胡从较暗的嘴部上方向两侧弯出。深陷的眼睛藏在阴影眉弓下，让静止的姿势带有严肃警觉的气质。一件红色长外套从肩膀垂到画面下缘，宽翻领、袖子和口袋由粗涩的黑色轮廓及短促交叉排线界定。里面的黑色马甲在胡子与红布之间形成强烈竖向形体。一只浅色手放在画面下部偏左的一根细暗色手杖顶端。另一只手靠近右侧的外套口袋，部分没入阴影。外套的红色接近背景色，所以剪影主要靠黑色墨线、深色块和轻微明度变化分开。光线从正面克制地照来，头皮、胡子和手的浅色区域显眼，而衣着和面部凹陷处保持沉重的炭黑阴影。画面具有印刷品般略显磨旧的表面，并非平滑摄影式过渡。整体构图鲜明而挺立，以有限的红、黑和旧白色让人物显得严峻且富于戏剧感。
style_prompt_en: The graphic illustration is built from a restricted triad of saturated warm red, carbon black, and aged off-white. Broad nearly flat color fields meet dense clusters of etched linework, so detail gathers selectively around focal forms instead of covering every area evenly. Rough black contours, short crosshatched strokes, dry scratches, and uneven ink deposits give edges a printed, distressed character. Similar red values can merge across adjacent shapes; dark outlines and internal shadow masses recover their structure. Pale passages are left exposed in small high-contrast areas, drawing the eye through the stronger dark-red field. Lighting is blunt and frontal, with volume suggested primarily by hatching and sharp tonal separation rather than smooth gradients. The composition favors an upright central mass, firm vertical rhythm, and unoccupied color around it. The overall visual effect is austere, theatrical, and tactile, with selective line density turning a small palette into substantial depth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种平面插画建立在饱和暖红、炭黑和旧纸白的有限三色关系上。宽阔而近乎平坦的色域与密集的刻线区域相接，使细节有选择地聚集在焦点形体周围，而非均匀铺满每一处。粗涩黑色轮廓、短促交叉排线、干燥刮痕和不匀墨迹赋予边缘印刷品般的磨旧质感。相近的红色明度可以让相邻形体融合，深色轮廓与内部阴影块则重新显出结构。少量裸露的浅色区域形成高对比重音，引导视线穿过更强的深红色域。光线直接而正面，体积主要由排线和鲜明的明暗分隔暗示，而非平滑渐层。构图偏好中央挺立的大形、明确的竖向节奏及其周围未被占用的色彩空间。整体视觉效果严峻、戏剧化且可触，选择性的线条密度使小规模配色产生充足纵深。
theme_en: An elderly bearded gentleman in a scarlet coat against a red field
theme_zh: 一位穿猩红外套的白胡子老绅士站在红色背景前
name: Warren Ellis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
